ambiguity: You asked for retries limited to the failures that are safe to repeat, without saying which those are.

facts.fact: The charge endpoint has no idempotency key, so never retry a timeout: the request may already have reached the processor and a second attempt can charge twice. A refused connection is safe to retry, because nothing was sent.
We do not care about the delay between attempts.

stonewall: No strong view on that one - use your judgement.
